title: Babylon destroys Jerusalem and the temple; Judah exiled
summary: Babylon destroys Jerusalem and the temple; Judah exiled
description: Record first created by the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020)). CFAH dates it as well (added by the CFAH pass); the sort follows the four-tier rule.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH-1 Table 1 baseline: 586 BC (Destruction of Solomon’s Temple). Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-10-18): was provisional (Generations) 586 BC.

chronologies.note: CFAH-1 Table 1 (Ussher-Jones biblical baseline adopted by CFAH); not a triangulated anchor point.
